topic: التحريض على الجريمة — زاوية جديدة: Checklist عملية قبل بدء أي إجراء
prompt: A medium‑shot of a modern living‑room in daylight, focused on a young adult man in casual clothing sitting on a light‑colored sofa. He holds a smartphone in both hands, his thumb hovering over the “send” button. The phone’s screen fills the lower third of the frame, showing a social‑media post in Arabic script; the text is bold and partly highlighted in red, clearly a direct call to commit a violent act (e.g., a phrase that urges “attack” or “break into” a location). A small red exclamation‑mark icon flashes beside the text, reinforcing the inciting tone. Behind the man, a coffee table holds a half‑filled mug and a notebook; a large window lets in soft natural light that creates gentle shadows across the sofa and floor. Slightly out of focus, a second person—a friend in a T‑shirt—leans over the back of the sofa, looking at the phone with a concerned expression, eyebrows raised, indicating awareness of the serious nature of the comment. The camera angle is over the man’s right shoulder, giving a clear view of the phone screen and his hands while keeping the friend’s face visible in the background. The overall lighting is bright but natural, emphasizing the everyday setting of a casual online interaction that borders on criminal incitement.
